summary: Removes the unpinned interpreter from the hot-path prompt-injection advisory runtime hook, locks advisory behavior with stdin fixtures, and records source-backed read-only hook enhancement candidates for future Rust/Buck2 checker lanes.

facets.F1_scope: P00 read-only hook enhancement cleanup slice; injection-content scanner extraction, governance hook tests, and backlog pointers changed.
facets.F2_source_authority: docs/AGENTS.md, specs/agent-hook-runtime-manifest.json, specs/repo-hygiene-automation.json, specs/masterplan.json, official GitHub Actions security guidance, Git hooks documentation, OWASP LLM Top 10, SLSA requirements, Kubernetes Pod Security Standards, CNCF Cloud Native Reference Architecture.

facets.F4_security: Preserves untrusted-tool-result advisory behavior, reduces host interpreter supply-chain exposure, and records future least-privilege/pinning/provenance/Kubernetes-restricted read-only checks without granting live authority.
facets.F5_privacy: Hook reads stdin payload only and emits stderr advisory; no payload persistence added.
facets.F6_reliability: Regression tests cover non-blocking exit, direct tool_response detection, content-block text detection, Codex tool_input detection, benign silence, and forbidden python3 reintroduction in the active hook file.
facets.F7_operability: Runtime hook command path remains unchanged; Buck2/Prow remain authoritative; runtime hook stays advisory and pointer-thin.
facets.F8_performance: Avoids spawning python3 for every PostToolUse payload scan; no new runtime dependency introduced.
facets.F9_maintainability: Backlog separates future read-only hook concerns into candidate_read_only_checks so lanes can implement disjoint Rust/Buck2 checkers rather than expanding shared scripts.
facets.F10_compatibility: Maintains exit 0 advisory contract and scans common tool_response/content/tool_input payload shapes.
facets.F11_supply_chain: No new dependencies; source references point to official/upstream guidance.
